_readme: Tools on the separate apps site (site.json > apps_url, PR #8 apps/). 'articles': article slugs that link the tool in their 'Free tools for this' box (at most 2 apps tools per article are shown). /tools/ lists every tool by group. Hidden when apps_url is empty. 'upcoming': tools that haven't shipped on the apps site yet; /tools/ lists them without a link. When one ships, move it to 'tools' with its path.
